entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. It doesn't track my heart rate correctly, which is its only job.
Okay, I can see how frustrating that would be. Sometimes a quick reset can solve that. If you have a moment, we could try—
Look, I don't have time for all that. I've already tried everything. I just want my money back. I need a refund.

I understand you're not interested in troubleshooting. Let me pull up your order information to check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you, Sam. One moment while I review your account... Okay, I see your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 38 days ago.
Just checking our policy. Okay, yes. According to my knowledge base, all of our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're at day 38, you're well within that 90-day window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Once we receive the item, we will issue the full refund.
Oh. Okay then. Good. That's all I wanted.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
